verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Wrangler commands, version rollbacks, and Git/GitHub Actions workflow fit. It does not document per-developer or per-branch environments, preview deployments, or limits on how many environments a team can run in parallel. The Sandbox SDK and the 'millions of agents' claims are runtime features for application code, not team development or shipping environments, so they are adjacent capabilities that earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up unlimited isolated environments so my whole team can ship simultaneously
